scientific_integrity: A proof is supplied for all n>=2. Binary map generation and direct multiplication validate small cases, not the infinite theorem.
scientific_limitations: Only idempotent centralizers and the idempotent-commuting induced graph are classified.
A broader equivalent result about order-preserving interval-image monoids could remain unidentified.
title: Idempotent centralizers and commuting semilattices in a finite directed-path monoid
